sections.title: The letter tse
paragraphs: The letter name is (цэ) /tsɛ/. Its main sound is heard in the word (цвет) /tsvʲet/, which means colour. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say tse
paragraphs: For the first sound, touch the ridge behind your upper teeth with your tongue. Stop the air, then release it into a quick hiss. Your voice stays off. Put a hand on your throat to feel that it does not shake. For the second sound, make the exact same mouth movements, but turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: When each sound applies
paragraphs: Usually, this letter makes its voiceless sound in all positions. You hear it at the start of (центр) /tsɛntr/ and at the end of (конец) /kɐˈnʲets/. The letter makes its voiced sound before a voiced consonant that blocks the air. You hear this sound change in (плацдарм) /plɐdzˈdarm/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not split this sound into two separate parts like cats in English. Treat the stop and the hiss as one quick burst. Also, do not soften the sound like the start of chair. Keep the middle of your tongue low and flat.
